culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fenix Intermediate LLC | Term Loan B - 10.76 % (SOFR + 6.75 %, 1.75 % Floor) | Amortized Cost 5,965,761 | Fair Value 5,869,079

findings.detail: The raw SOI rows carry populated fair value cells, but B01 reports only 93 of 186 extracted leaves with fair_value.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate completeness flag. Raw source is readable and shows the SOI has populated fair value cells on leaf rows, for example table 5 row 4 with fair value 5,869,079, and the current schedule totals to fair value 221,817,660 at table 8 row 20. The source therefore does not explain the 93/186 fair_value population rate as blank filing data; the flag reflects a real extraction completeness defect.
